title: Retrospective reconstruction on papers 1 and 2 (development set): protocol demonstration, not evidence

meta.why_retrospective: the outcomes of papers 1 and 2 were published before this ledger was written; the instrument was developed by inspecting them
meta.quantities: results[benchmark][intervention][quantity]; *.delta = after - before on the evaluation split
meta.voiding_rule: a prediction is voided, not scored, when its intervention fails the invariance check (cross-model difficulty agreement on survivors < 0.6)

predictions.note: LLM accuracy falls by more than 8 points absolute
LLM-minus-retrieval gap widens by at least 5 points (paper 1: advantage concentrated on novel cases)
exact match rises by more than 15 points under the grammar
verified semantic correctness moves by less than 3 points
SVG does not shrink monotonically with model size (H2 discriminator, most likely to fail)
abstention-aware scoring reorders models on the benchmark with the highest pre-intervention AF
